The Doobie Brothers – Minute By Minute

Artist: The Doobie Brothers

Up for sale is a very nice copy of Minute By Minute, one of The Doobie Brothers' most successful albums featuring Michael McDonald during the band's peak years.

Includes Classic Songs

  • What a Fool Believes
  • Minute by Minute
  • Dependin' on You
  • Here to Love You
  • Sweet Feelin'
  • Open Your Eyes
  • Don't Stop to Watch the Wheels

Winner of the Grammy Award for Album of the Year, this album remains one of the defining releases of late-'70s classic rock.
